modeHint.oneway: Send a one-way remote procedure call (RPC) request to the device without waiting for a response.
modeHint.twoway: Send a two-way remote procedure call (RPC) request to the device and wait for its response.

help.method: Name of the method used to distinguish RPC calls, e.g. setGpio.
help.params: Parameters used to process the request, as a JSON object; use {'{}'} when no parameters are needed.
help.timeout: Processing timeout in milliseconds. Default is 10000, minimum is 5000.
help.persistent: A persistent RPC is stored first and delivered once the device comes online; its status is listed below.
help.retries: How many times a persistent RPC is re-sent on network or device-side failures.
help.additionalInfo: Metadata of the persistent RPC written to RPC events, as a JSON object.

delete.content: Are you sure you want to delete this persistent RPC call? This action cannot be undone.

validation.methodPattern: The RPC method may only contain letters, digits and "_"
validation.invalidParams: RPC params is not valid JSON
validation.invalidAdditionalInfo: Additional info is not valid JSON

result.title: Response
result.empty: No RPC request has been sent yet
result.accepted: Request delivered, the device returned no content
